scope: adva-library directory partition and admission gates
axioms: location-grants-nothing: a file gains no semantic status by sitting in a directory; registration is explicit and checkable
one-home-cross-directory-is-reference: every entry has exactly one home; cross-topic references are documentary views, never derivation parents, implicit imports or permission transfers
promotion-requires-new-contract: journal-to-epoch, proposed-to-native and documentary-to-Seal moves each require a new versioned bounded contract; no in-place rewriting of pinned bytes

directories.checker: SHA-256 byte pins in index.json and math/constraints
directories.growth_rule: additive documented pins only; the two Pascal files remain byte-immutable
only by a new contract version; runtime outputs never stored here

directories.checker: adva_witness::load_library_v0 full parent-chain replay with fresh Rust derivations
directories.growth_rule: append-only via a bounded checked run; existing snapshots never overwritten; no mutable latest pointer

directories.checker: complete-stage regeneration replay with field comparison
directories.growth_rule: additive stages; rejected, Open and Unknown outcomes retained; decoding alone never authorizes reuse

directories.checker: python3 python/adva/adva.py math-check (schema, one-home, topic coverage, bounded references, byte pins)
directories.growth_rule: explicit reviewed catalog edit with version bump; the operative bounds are LIMITS in python/adva/math_catalog.py and are 101 entries / 256 reference occurrences / 120 files / 256 KiB per metadata file / 8 MiB per referenced file / 32 MiB total read / 5 s cooperative deadline

directories.checker: pinned parent commit, source digests, dependency versions, observed controls
directories.growth_rule: additive records; not a crypto audit, not a fresh experiment claim

directories.checker: exact commit per gitlink; .gitmodules must match the index
directories.growth_rule: new vendor only by explicit review; no local edits to vendored sources
additive; fixtures never promoted to native words by directory placement

directories.role: declared fixture home (finite product question, program, requests)
directories.growth_rule: additive; requests are bounded evidence inputs

cross_directory_rules: Geometry successors cite same-home parents whose chains reach the pinned pascal-research-presentations root; external references and Q4/M6 are never derivation parents.
Topics (arithmetic/geometry/logic) are views, not homes; shared topic membership grants no ownership, import or identity.
A candidate logic cannot select or replace the checker that admits it.
The run phase records .adva output as bytes, never interprets it; transport does not confer admission.

Trial outputs (reports, contracts, tampered controls, archives) live outside the library under docs/research/<NNNN>-evidence/; a local experiment directory is a live frame and must be dropped there with its receipts, or declared a local-only experiment in its driver.
Vendored external sources are pinned by exact commit; no local edits.
admission_procedure: Declare: home directory, theory/version, assumptions, finite scope, recorded status, materials with SHA-256, evidence, checker/version/source, reuse requirements, open obligations.
Check: run the declared checker under its bounded contract; record exit status and residuals.
Accept: where the task declares human acceptance (0157 F3), retain the acceptance record; a signature is provenance, not acceptance.
Commit: additive change only; historical pins remain unchanged.
revision_discipline: Policy changes require an explicit versioned contract, never a reinterpretation of v0.
The checker never updates a digest for the user; fingerprint changes require a reviewed catalog edit.
The growth obligation and its documentary seal are immutable; discharge requires the listed native prerequisites.
No directory change maps topics to compute/verify/learn or Rust/Lean/Metamath.
open_obligations: free: task-relative predicate not yet chosen (0157 candidate F1/F2/F3); native free command absent; contract free phase remains AdapterUnavailable/NotRun.
drop/thread: intended thread dual and the preserved observation are Open (0158); the F7^2 linear fixture is externally supplied.
growth: geometry growth obligation Open; native Seal NotIssued.
hygiene: .gitmodules empty while four gitlinks exist; pysnark untracked circuit artifacts; research number 0158 shared with the unmerged disclosure branch.
